name: Proving Grounds
summary: Proving Grounds is an initiation rite required of any Horde warrior who seeks to join the Frostwolf Clan's campaign in Alterac Valley. To prove their worth, recruits must brave the gnoll-infested Wildpaw Cavern and recover a lost clan standard.

sections.title: The Call to Arms
sections.body: Before any soldier of the Horde is trusted to fight alongside General Drek'Thar's forces in Alterac Valley, they must prove their spirit is primed for war. Warmaster Laggrond tests newly arrived champions by sending them straight into hostile territory. This trial separates ordinary travelers from true warriors capable of answering the ancient call to battle and channeling the clan's ancestral fury.

sections.title: Trial in the Wildpaw Cavern
sections.body: The initiation demands braving the Wildpaw Cavern, a cold cave system south of the Frostwolf stronghold swarming with aggressive local gnolls. Somewhere deep inside the burrows lies an abandoned Frostwolf banner. Recovering this emblem under the fangs and claws of the Wildpaw beasts demonstrates courage, resilience, and battle readiness to the warmasters.

sections.title: Earning the Insignia
sections.body: Returning the retrieved banner to Laggrond completes the rite. With their spirit deemed fully awakened to the conflict, the recruit receives a Frostwolf initiate's insignia. This trinket serves as a badge of honor and a symbol of allegiance, marking the warrior's first official step toward rising through the clan's esteemed ranks.

faq.q: What is the purpose of the Proving Grounds rite?
faq.answer: The rite tests newly arrived Horde soldiers to verify they possess the martial spirit and grit necessary to endure the brutal war against the Stormpike dwarves in Alterac Valley.

faq.q: Who gives the quest and where do I find them?
faq.answer: Warmaster Laggrond gives the quest. He is stationed in Alterac Valley, ready to test and induct recruits who seek to join the Frostwolf Clan's ranks.

faq.q: Where is the Frostwolf Banner located?
faq.answer: The banner is hidden deep inside the Wildpaw Cavern, a gnoll-infested cave situated southeast of the main Frostwolf base in Alterac Valley.

faq.q: What creatures dwell inside the Wildpaw Cavern?
faq.answer: The cavern is held by the Wildpaw gnolls, a hostile tribe adapted to the freezing mountains that savagely defends its underground dens from intruders.

faq.q: What is the significance of the Frostwolf insignia?
faq.answer: The insignia marks an adventurer as an accepted initiate of the Frostwolf Clan. As recruits prove themselves further and rise in standing, the warmaster replaces it with more prestigious badges of rank.

faq.q: What is the Frostwolf Clan's stake in Alterac Valley?
faq.answer: Alterac Valley has long been the ancestral sanctuary of the Frostwolf orcs since their exile during the First War. They fiercely guard its valleys against the intrusion of the dwarven Stormpike Guard.

angles.text: Every soldier of the Horde must earn their place in the eyes of the Frostwolves before marching out across the icy plains of Alterac.
For orcs, returning the banner to the Frostwolf Clan honors the venerable traditions and ancestral home established by Chieftain Durotan.
The trial is designed to stir martial fury and hone instincts, ensuring recruits are ready for the brutal clash of arms against the Stormpike vanguard.
